title: Irrigation Design, Flow, Pressure, Uniformity & Maintenance
description: Specialist module covering irrigation hydraulics concepts, measured emitter output, uniformity, filtration/clogging, maintenance and evidence-based fault handoff.
learningOutcomes: Explain how source pressure, regulator performance, line losses, emitter characteristics and filtration affect delivered irrigation and why design specifications do not prove installed performance.
Measure representative emitter output and distribution uniformity using a repeatable sampling plan, appropriate units and controlled comparison conditions.
Diagnose localized and zone-level irrigation faults using flow, pressure, filtration, clogging, controller-command, spatial-pattern and root-zone evidence.
Evaluate preventive maintenance and sanitation needs for filters, emitters and irrigation components while preserving protected-service and chemical-safety boundaries.

Produce a reconstructable irrigation verification and maintenance handoff linking zone identity, command history, measured delivery, pressure/flow evidence, root-zone consequence and authorized next action.
